what: TCPMT round 3 --- tier order of a converter cell with MIXED tiers.
rule: production order = among the orders of the decided tiers meeting the via rule (AR <= 1 on every via level, die terminals on both faces) -- or, if none meets it, among those of the best worst-via aspect ratio -- the order of least intra-VR routing loss (the ledger's model at 25 C, the 48-V nets at the hot-loop factor; each order with its part assignment of least routing loss among those of its best worst-via aspect ratio); orders within 0.1 W of the least loss are separated by the heat path

routing.model: final_closure_ledger.intra_vr (R0 lateral, R0 via stacks, output-plane R2), all cells

terminal_assumption.both: production (authors' stated assumption): a die connects through the capture planes on both faces of its tier
terminal_assumption.single: sensitivity: dies face the input end, terminals on that face only

m36.chosen_basis: no order of the decided tiers meets the via rule: least routing loss among the orders of the best worst-via aspect ratio (heat path between orders within 0.1 W)

single_face.what: RULE applied with single-face terminals (dies face the input end; each order's assignment chosen on its single-face aspect ratio): the order it picks, and the chosen order's single-face worst via

repartition_search.note: every packable grouping of the cell's parts into at most 4 tiers, every order; the production order is chosen among the decided tiers' orders (the decided stack)
